item.title: WWII-era plane packed into boxes in 1953 moved with its owner for 50 years before restoration
item.description: The WACO UPF-7 was used as a primary trainer from 1941, helping prepare pilots through the US government-backed Civilian Pilot Training Program during the World War II era. Retired in 1953, the aircraft was bought by a Florida owner who dismantled and packed it into boxes, carrying the parts through three moves over 50 years. Rediscovered in 2002, it was later restored by RARE Aircraft and returned to airworthy condition before being displayed at the Historic Flight Foundation. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Rusia lanza ataques aéreos contra Ucrania en medio del regreso a clases en los colegios
item.description: Ucrania sufrió una nueva serie de ataques aéreos rusos que dejaron varias víctimas. Según las autoridades, un depósito ferroviario fue alcanzado, al igual que un edificio residencial, mientras el país siguió intentando seguir con las labores cotidianas con los alumnos regresando a los colegios. Por su parte, Rusia afirma que solo atacó infraestructuras militares y energéticas. También aseguró haber atacado los puertos de Odesa y Chornomorsk. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: French astronaut takes third spacewalk outside ISS in all-female mission
item.description: French astronaut Sophie Adenot is taking her third spacewalk in two weeks and is leading rare all-female excursion outside ISS. The main mission is to replace a retroreflector, a device that align modules when they arrive towards the space station. Other maintenance operations are planned. The whole excursion is supposed to last between six and six and a half hours. It is only the sixth all-female excursion in space history. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: From wedding ceremonies to sunsets with pumpkins, even in urinals, Kusama’s work brought joy, mischief and inspiration to so many I have always loved Yayoi Kusama’s work, and when I visited an exhibition of hers on a gap year in Sydney I was spellbound by her infinity mirror rooms. I immediately thought, despite being single at the time, this is a fantastic space to propose in. Fast forward around eight years and I am on one knee holding a ring out to my partner inside an infinity mirror room in Helsinki, with excited and expectant Finns looking on. He said yes. item.description: Eve Irvine is pleased to welcome Anne, the co-founder of SOS Périscolaire in French.
